geography_note: The ten assembly segments are confirmed from public electoral sources. Localities are deliberately limited to names anchored to their own segment (or to the seat itself); South Extension, Panchsheel Park, Andrews Ganj, New Moti Bagh and Kirti Nagar were dropped because their segment could not be verified. Every locality must still be proven against the target database's geography_data before --execute will run.

cases.title: Uncollected household waste
cases.description: Household waste has remained uncollected near the neighbourhood collection point for several days, causing odour and scattered litter.

cases.title: Roadside dumping at market edge
cases.description: Repeated roadside dumping is obstructing the service lane and attracting animals; removal and monitoring are requested.

cases.title: Public toilet requires sanitation repairs
cases.description: The public toilet block serving the local market has broken fixtures, blocked drainage and inadequate cleaning.

cases.title: Blocked municipal surface drain
cases.description: A surface drain beside the residential lane is blocked with silt and waste, leaving stagnant water after routine washing and rain.

cases.title: Damaged walkway inside neighbourhood park
cases.description: Broken paving on the public park walkway creates a tripping hazard and prevents comfortable use by older residents.

cases.title: Persistently low water pressure
cases.description: Tap-water pressure remains extremely low during the regular morning supply window across several adjoining lanes.

cases.title: Sewer chamber overflowing onto road
cases.description: Sewage is overflowing from a chamber onto the internal road and requires cleaning and inspection for blockage.

cases.title: Discoloured tap-water supply
cases.description: The local supply is discoloured and has an unusual odour; pipeline testing and flushing are requested.

cases.title: Damaged sewer chamber cover
cases.description: A damaged sewer chamber cover creates a pedestrian and traffic hazard and allows wastewater to escape during peak flow.

cases.title: Residential streetlights not working
cases.description: Multiple streetlights remain non-functional along a residential stretch, leaving the area poorly illuminated after dark.

cases.title: Repeated voltage fluctuations
cases.description: Repeated voltage fluctuations are affecting household appliances; the local distribution line requires inspection.

cases.title: Market-area streetlight cluster dark
cases.description: A cluster of public streetlights near the market has remained dark and requires an electrical maintenance inspection.

cases.title: Deep potholes on busy road
cases.description: A damaged road surface and deep potholes are forcing vehicles into unsafe manoeuvres during busy hours.

cases.title: Uneven and broken footpath slabs
cases.description: Broken and uneven footpath slabs obstruct wheelchair users and pedestrians and require reconstruction.

cases.title: Damaged public bus shelter
cases.description: The bus shelter has a damaged roof and missing passenger-information panel, reducing usability during bad weather.

cases.title: Ration-card e-KYC service delay
cases.description: A synthetic beneficiary workflow reports that ration-card e-KYC remains pending although the submitted details are complete.

cases.title: Old-age pension verification delay
cases.description: A synthetic old-age-pension service request remains at document-verification stage without a clear deficiency notice.

cases.title: Welfare centre lacks accessible approach
cases.description: A public assistance centre lacks an accessible approach and clear guidance for persons with disabilities seeking welfare services.
cases.department: Office of State Commissioner for Persons with disabilities

cases.title: Pedestrian path obstructed by encroachment
cases.description: Temporary structures and stored material are blocking a pedestrian path and forcing people onto the carriageway.

cases.title: Unauthorised construction debris on public land
cases.description: Construction material from an apparently unauthorised alteration has occupied public space and obstructed safe access.
